description: On desktop, each of Studio's own windows (Studio, Halonic Inbox, Halonic Messenger) hears the feedback shortcut while it is focused and may start a capture of its own area through plugin:feedback|start, hand the box drawn on its see-through overlay to plugin:feedback|select, or end the feedback with plugin:feedback|end (HAL-18778). The caller must be the focused, visible, not minimised window: start is refused as not_focused otherwise, so a window behind another app never captures that app. The still covers only the calling window, only that window may select from it, and no system-wide key is registered. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
